title: solution-architect -> python-backend-engineer / api-testing-engineer handoff
description: Encodes the INPUT/OUTPUT contract in docs/orchestration/02-architecture-workflow.md, section 'INTERFACE CONTRACTS', block 2. fr_refs/FR-pattern fields validate structural presence of an FR reference, not that the referenced FR exists in SRS.md -- referential integrity across documents is intentionally out of scope for this schema: the payload carries no master FR list to check against (would require bundling srs_fr_list into this contract, or a separate SRS.md-reading script).

hld_interface_contracts.description: Per-zone read/write API definitions from the approved HLD, keyed path -> method -> {purpose, auth_scope}. Mirrors the real openapi.yaml paths: shape (path-only outer key, HTTP method nested one level under each path) and HLD.md Section 7's per-endpoint table. Object keys are unique by construction, so no two entries can share the same path, and no two methods can collide under the same path.

openapi_version.description: Structured assertion mirroring the openapi_spec file's declared version -- a JSON Schema validating this handoff payload cannot inspect the referenced YAML file's content directly, so the payload must carry this fact explicitly.

endpoints.description: Every operation emitted into openapi_spec, keyed path -> method -> {...} (same native-uniqueness shape as the input block). Each operation carries at least one FR reference, mirroring how the real openapi.yaml tags every operation/tag with FR-NNN in its description/tags block.

assumes.const: sync REST/gRPC read path, async write path (per Team Alignment section)

must_not.const: introduce new endpoints not traceable to an HLD component
